population.selectionRule: latest timestamp, unique canonical title, tie broken by larger item ID

facts.strategy: Significance-weighted co-rated cosine, lambda 25, baseline plus weighted rating deviations

commonSupportedSubset.note: Only comparable where both methods produced a non-fallback prediction. A fallback is a design decision, not a scoring error.

performance.note: Recorded in the verification runtime; the browser figure is measured separately.

checks.name: one record per user, no duplicates
no hidden pair leaks into its own recommendation history
every prediction is finite and inside the rating scale
accuracy is reported over the common supported subset
